title: M: move the middle, keep both sides
recognition: Both side blocks are complete. The middle slice is one M′ away from its reference.
physicalChecks: Show the two unchanged blocks.
Check which center returns to the bottom.
stepNotes: Turn M. Check the completed target against both side colors.

title: M′: the other direction is useful too
recognition: Both blocks are intact. The highlighted middle cycle needs the inverse direction.
physicalChecks: M′ undoes this displacement in one turn.
Do not add three M turns just because M is familiar.
stepNotes: Turn M'. Check the completed target against both side colors.
